notification_ack.picture_taken_and_image_change: No unsolicited notification Ack is established in the traced DP-67/WiView handlers. WiView's common 0x28664 follow-up drains attachment bytes, not an Ack writer.
notification_ack.image_packets: Preserve the separately evidenced image-transfer Ack/Nak paths. A packet reply and an unsolicited notification are different protocol contexts.
notification_ack.limit: All direct Ack/Nak literal references are listed; this is bounded static analysis, not a proof about every possible dynamic string construction.

error_0x01.semantics: A generic no-current-handler dispatch branch constructs Error error_code=0x01; Ack is absent from the nine registered PDA command names. This is not a GetImage-specific busy diagnosis.
error_0x01.get_image_distinction: The traced GetImage lookup failure passes standard-error enum 3, mapped to error_code=0x02; image-processing failures use a separate error attribute (e.g. 1ffc/8002). Standard enum 2 is also mapped to 0x01 by the generic constructor, so the numeric code alone is not a unique cause.
error_0x01.causality_limit: A superfluous notification Ack could yield an uncorrelated Error that a pending GetImage accepts. This fits the reported symptom but no Valeo firmware dump, live capture or device reproduction was performed here.

capture_path.dp67: OnPictureTaken consumes the complete file_name, splits on '/', requires first component '.', and resolves the corresponding cached file object. CDOSFile::Cache uses its complete name in the same CProtocolLayer::GetImage used for normal downloads; no auto-only basename substitution was established.
capture_path.busy: Explicit busy=yes is handled as busy/calibration state. This attribute must not be inferred from error_code=0x01.
capture_path.wiview: The PictureTaken parser recognizes parametersReady=yes and imageSaved=yes; notification processing records image model states 0/1/2 respectively, with imageSaved taking precedence. It retains the complete notified path. The extra 0x25570 call in the saved branch performs two-word bookkeeping arithmetic; it is not established as a download-queue operation.
capture_path.download_state_gate: GetBitmapBase 0x51234..0x516fc resolves cache/request variants then constructs GetImage at 0x5143c; no image-state==2 requirement is present in this traced construction path. Notification/UI state handling is not evidence that every automatic preview must await imageSaved. No new universal parametersReady gate is established.
capture_path.image_change: Has a separate route and invalidation notification; does not justify acknowledging or starting an overlapping binary download unconditionally.

gray_pick.sync_dimensions: picturedimensions is parsed as two comma-separated integers; max becomes the landscape grid width W, min its height H (0x2feb4..0x2ff64). Sync target is global+8, so target+0x104/+0x108 become global+0x10c/+0x110.
gray_pick.full_grid: Getters 0x38f10/0x38f28 return W-1/H-1; initial full-preview ROI adds 1 at 0x78a90..0x78ab4, making [0,W)x[0,H).
gray_pick.screen_to_roi: 0x76678..0x76790 scales tap x/y by current ROI width/height divided by displayed image rectangle width/height, then adds ROI origin. The resulting image-grid point is passed to the gray handler at 0x76860.

orientation.edge_note: The traced rotation subtracts from W/H, without an explicit -1. Do not silently present an alternative convention as vendor behavior.

portrait_bitmap_bridge.orientation_to_wrapper: 0x5522c reads the photo model orientation; 0x5523c calls wrapper 0x54d98 with that value and the decoded bitmap.
portrait_bitmap_bridge.wrapper: 0x54d98..0x54f3c reads decoded bitmap dimensions. Landscape=2 expects width>=height. Portrait CCW/CW expects height>=width, logging a mismatch if width>height. For a normal portrait bitmap, 0x54ee8..0x54f18 calls 0x955a4 with angle 270 for CW=1 or 90 for CCW=0, then swaps wrapper width/height.
portrait_bitmap_bridge.rotation_helper: 0x955a4..0x95814 allocates the swapped bitmap and calls pixel kernel 0x94de4. DIB constructor 0x92cfc writes a positive height at 0x92d1c. For this 24-bit bottom-up DIB, the kernel's 90 branch (0x94ee8..0x94f94) is visually clockwise; its 270 branch (0x950f4..0x951b0) is counterclockwise.
portrait_bitmap_bridge.inference: The PDA rotates a portrait JPEG into a temporary landscape display bitmap; the gray handler restores that display rotation. An Android view of the unchanged original JPEG must not apply the PDA rotation again. With full FIT and consistent photo metadata, normalized JPEG position maps directly to Landscape W by H or Portrait H by W camera grid.
portrait_bitmap_bridge.pixel_edge_convention: Kernel pixel indices use -1, whereas the separate gray-point edge transform subtracts from W/H. An Android normalized-grid floor/clamp rule is an explicit boundary choice, not asserted bit-identical legacy rounding.

gray_pick.supported_android_subset: Full FIT request only; explicit per-photo Landscape, Portrait CW or Portrait CCW bound to the current preview bytes; positive PictureDimensions; unchanged JPEG decode with no additional EXIF/display rotation or unknown crop; JPEG direction/aspect consistent with the grid. Map normalized JPEG position directly to W by H for Landscape or H by W for either Portrait. Reject Auto, missing or contradictory metadata; do not call this MOS sensor pixels.
gray_pick.remaining_limits: Arbitrary zoom ROI, unknown crops and automatic EXIF rotations remain outside this bridge. Aspect agreement is a consistency check, not evidence of an otherwise unknown crop. No hardware gray-sample accuracy test was performed; tapping white material does not guarantee a valid exposure/gray result.
